recognize_zh: EDTA 抽血管上段內壁（紅色箭頭）附著一小團不規則、淡黃白至粉紅色的顆粒狀物質，與血液分離；在脂肪栓塞疑慮及分析儀出現血塊／干擾警示的情況下，這種管內顆粒提示脂肪顆粒（需與小血塊區分，可做濕片與脂肪染色確認）。
features: Photograph of the upper portion of a labeled EDTA whole-blood collection tube
Small, irregular, pale yellow-white to pinkish particulate aggregate adhering to the inner tube wall (red arrow)
Aggregate is separate from the blood column, with only faint red droplets on the wall
No gross fibrin strands or dark red clot visible in this view
describe_en: Photograph of an EDTA whole-blood collection tube shows a small, irregular, pale yellow-white to pinkish particulate aggregate adhering to the inner wall of the upper tube (red arrow), separate from the blood column. No dark red fibrin clot is visible in this view. The gross appearance alone cannot distinguish lipid from a small pale clot or tissue fragment; however, in a patient with suspected fat embolism and analyzer interference flags, it is suggestive of fat particles, which should be confirmed by wet-mount examination and fat staining.

ddx.vs: A clot is typically red to dark red with fibrin strands and is associated with falsely low platelet counts, whereas fat is pale, refractile and floats, dissolving in lipid solvents and staining with Oil red O.

ddx.dx: Tissue or skin plug from venipuncture
ddx.vs: A tissue fragment is a single firm cored piece that shows epithelial or connective tissue on smear, rather than soft, oily globules.
Lipemia produces diffuse milky turbidity of the plasma rather than discrete particles adherent to the tube wall.
